scope: alpha-next-c1 queue (arm table, budget, arm control, grade with the C1 additions, derived texts, arm loop, post-run report) hub CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: arm-control-fake-client
leaves.replaces: The engine control client replies to native_stage_local with and without the overlap field, and the status block with and without stage_overlap
leaves.equivalence: The question is what the arm does with each reply: forward overlap, record the stage switch, refuse a reply or a status that does not prove the C1 selection. The field names are the engine's (test_alpha_next_c1_queue.Forwarding reads native_overlap_session's forwarding from the source).
leaves.cannot_prove: The real control plane with an OverlapSegmentDriver installed; that the engine honours the selection

leaves.name: c1-emitter-overlap-order
leaves.replaces: The engine log of a C1-on arm: alpha-next's emitter (test_alpha_next_queue.AlphaEmit) with a successor opened early, its flushes interleaved, one flash-s5 stage-overlap line per transaction after the stage-local line, memory and memory-peak receipts in the PLAN 2 writer's format
leaves.equivalence: The line formats are the engine's (C1Parity reads stage_overlap.py and native_measurement.py). The order (successor open before the predecessor's release, one host command in flight per stage) is the one test_e3_stage_overlap and test_alpha_c1_box prove on the real composition.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real timing, real memory values, the order under the composition of 382ed704 (lean replies on successors)

leaves.name: c1-mutants
leaves.replaces: Engine faults: no early open, two host commands in flight on one stage, a torn overlap line, a lost engine flush on an on-arm, an OOM counter rise, an overlap signature line
leaves.equivalence: Each mutant edits one line or one stamp of the synthetic log; the grade must name the fault and fail or hold the arm as declared.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the engine produces these faults in these forms

leaves.name: arm-loop-clients
leaves.replaces: The arm CLI and the check client in the arm loop (stub box arm, stub checks, fake nvidia-smi/docker/systemctl); the grade and the read are the real e3_alpha_next_c1_box over the synthetic run
leaves.equivalence: The loop body is the derived draft text, run under real bash with SECONDS jumps for the entry limits and a verbatim engine-death line for the crash path.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real arm walls; the engine's crash forms beyond the declared death line

leaves.name: report-synthetic-run
leaves.replaces: A box run directory for tools/alpha_next_c1_report.py: the synthetic core run's arm records and engine log
leaves.equivalence: The report wraps alpha_next_report with the grade's own regroup; the test checks the keys and that a regrouped C1-on chunk holds its own commands.
leaves.cannot_prove: The report over a real run's log (rotation, compressed parts, real tears)

leaves.name: grade-raises-inside
leaves.replaces: alpha-next's grade (an.grade) by one that raises RuntimeError('inside'), for one call
leaves.equivalence: a failure inside the composed grade; the test checks the C1 grade's temporary module seams are restored on the exception path as on the normal one
leaves.cannot_prove: nothing about the real grade's verdicts; those run unpatched in the same suite
